name: Canosa di Puglia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Canosa di Puglia (a fleur-de-lis and bend on blue, and crosses on red).
history: Municipal flag of Canosa di Puglia, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 11 August 1934.

features.role: Canosa di Puglia arms — fleur-de-lis and bend on blue, and crosses on red, crowned
